candidates.reason: Reads left to right with comfortable spacing, but the heart-in-hand motif is broken: the heart sits alone in the middle with a bite cut out where the thumb used to be, and the hand is stranded at the far right, cropped at the top edge and holding nothing. The CTA headline is almost the same size as the main headline, so they compete, and the small contact lines are slightly ragged against the CTA's left edge.

The headline is strong, but the heart has shrunk to a small, detached blob below the empty hand, so the key image is lost. The hand is cropped at the top edge. The CTA column on the right is cramped: it starts at the top edge, has tight leading, and its contact copy runs down to the bottom edge, leaving '@thekindestheart' orphaned on its own line.

Has the same detached tiny heart and top-cropped hand as candidate 2. The CTA here wraps into five cramped lines that crowd against the hand on the left and fill the column from the top edge to the bottom edge with no margin. 'Twitter @thekindestheart' sits right on the bottom edge, and the column is overstuffed while the headline area has room to spare.

The original is just shrunk into a narrow strip in the centre with huge empty areas on both sides. The headline, URL, CTA and contact text are all tiny and the contact lines can't be read. Nothing was rearranged for the banner shape.
